title: Sunny kitchen, no lights
blurb: At 14:10 sunlight floods the kitchen. Alex walks in and nothing happens, although both models wanted the lights on.

steps.text: Two in the afternoon on a bright Tuesday. Sunlight floods the kitchen; Sam is in the living room.
Alex walks in to make coffee.
Both models wanted the lights on here (2B 34%, 12B 70%). The reflex checks the light level first, and the scene decider is not asked when someone simply enters a room.
Rules handle the reflexes; the models are asked only when words or activity need understanding.
